benchmarks.name: Intent integrity
benchmarks.challenge: Remove essential product intent from an otherwise plausible brief.
benchmarks.passesWhen: The workflow asks, researches or records the gap instead of silently inventing it.

benchmarks.name: Generic-prior convergence
benchmarks.challenge: Generate without style clichés being named or banned.
benchmarks.passesWhen: Material visual choices are product-specific and traceable; common patterns are justified rather than counted mechanically.

benchmarks.name: Design-system fidelity
benchmarks.challenge: Implement against pinned tokens and component identities.
benchmarks.passesWhen: No fabricated token, detached clone or silent component mutation is introduced.

benchmarks.name: Design-code round trip
benchmarks.challenge: Move a canonical screen through design and code representations and back.
benchmarks.passesWhen: Component identity, semantics, variants, constraints, annotations and states remain accounted for.

benchmarks.name: State completeness
benchmarks.challenge: Exercise loading, empty, partial, error, denied, degraded and success states as applicable.
benchmarks.passesWhen: All applicable states are usable, distinguishable and evidenced.

benchmarks.name: Content torture
benchmarks.challenge: Use long, short, missing, unsafe-looking and extreme data fixtures.
benchmarks.passesWhen: Meaning and operation survive without clipping, overlap or demo-only assumptions.

benchmarks.name: Localization and RTL
benchmarks.challenge: Apply representative expansion and right-to-left layout.
benchmarks.passesWhen: Reading order, alignment, controls and content remain correct.

benchmarks.name: Accessibility adversary
benchmarks.challenge: Test semantics, keyboard, focus, zoom, contrast, motion and assistive-technology behavior.
benchmarks.passesWhen: Applicable requirements pass with automated and targeted human evidence.

benchmarks.name: Environmental responsiveness
benchmarks.challenge: Vary viewport, container, input, text size and preferences.
benchmarks.passesWhen: The experience adapts intentionally rather than merely shrinking.

benchmarks.name: Surgical-change regression
benchmarks.challenge: Request a narrow change with explicit mutation locks.
benchmarks.passesWhen: Requested dimensions change and locked dimensions remain stable.

benchmarks.name: Prototype-production integrity
benchmarks.challenge: Evaluate the integrated runtime rather than a screenshot.
benchmarks.passesWhen: Build, behavior, performance, metadata, security assumptions and maintainability gates are evidenced as applicable.

benchmarks.name: Correction cost
benchmarks.challenge: Track the whole route to accepted output.
benchmarks.passesWhen: Attempts, calls, credits, time, interventions and regressions are reported without guessed values.

benchmarks.name: Rationale integrity
benchmarks.challenge: Request explanations for material choices after generation.
benchmarks.passesWhen: Answers trace to prior contract, decision and evidence rather than generic post-hoc language.

benchmarks.name: Uncertainty integrity
benchmarks.passesWhen: The workflow preserves uncertainty and escalates blocking unknowns rather than fabricating certainty.
